english.note: Use this colloquial word for the boss or person in charge, not for the broader expert sense of English “head.”

examples.english: The head of my team told me to come in early tomorrow.
examples.traditional: 我阿頭叫我聽日返早啲。
examples.jyutping: ngo5 aa3 tau4 giu3 ngo5 ting1 jat6 faan1 zou2 di1
